_note: Bloc proposals, V1.3d. Shaped after the real Stability and Growth Pact and the Excessive Deficit Procedure, but the numbers are game numbers set by tools/bloc_probe.gd and not by the Treaties -- see docs/bloc-model.md. File order is the council's agenda: src/sim/bloc.gd rotates an index over the loaded list, so a proposal added here changes what comes up and when. V3.3 re-measured the council over 27 members: the authored positions produced unanimous or near-unanimous divisions in which no member's abstention could matter, so debt_reduction_rule's position was re-set by tools/ (the tally probe) to land the division inside the player's pivotal band -- 385 for of 639 cast against a 351.45 threshold, so France's 81 seats decide it whichever way they vote.

proposals.name: Stability and Growth Pact
proposals.summary: Members undertake to hold the general government deficit under 3% of GDP. The Commission reports on those who do not, and the Council may levy a penalty.

proposals.name: Debt Reduction Rule
proposals.summary: A member carrying debt above 90% of GDP commits to a path back below it. The path is not enforced; the reporting is -- and the sponsorship is the green-liberal benches, whose fiscal hawkery is the debt brake's natural home in this council.

proposals.name: Minimum Corporate Rate
proposals.summary: A floor under corporation tax across the bloc, so that no member can compete for headquarters by cutting below it.
